caption: The drawing features a central, detailed grayscale depiction of a lidded urn or trophy with two ornate side handles. The urn has a rounded, ribbed body, a domed lid topped with a small sculpted finial, and stands on a tiered circular pedestal. Each handle is curved and symmetrically attached to the sides of the urn's body. Decorative bands with intricate patterns encircle the rim of the lid and the base of the body. In the upper left corner, there is a circular inset showing a close-up of the finial, which appears to be a floral or leaf motif. In the lower left corner, a small schematic drawing of the urn displays measurements: 9 7/8 inches in width, 10 1/2 inches in height, and 4 7/8 inches at the base. In the lower right corner, another inset features a horizontal band of ornamental design used on the urn. The drawing consists of fine, precise lines and shading in black and shades of gray on a light beige background.
title: Silver Sugar Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
